text:
nina: Heads up 1: I'm about to start a multi-PR refactor to reorganize the reference docs: moving /reference -> /platform/reference, extracting examples into /snippets, and adding explicit redirect rules. It's going to be split across 3 PRs. Need reviewers and a merge cadence.
harry: timeline?
nina: open PRs today, merge PR1 (moves + basic redirects) during the 10:30-11:30 PT merge window, then PR2 (snippets extract) + PR3 (TOC & anchor fixes) next day. We should avoid merging more than one PR at a time while redirects propagate.
raj: what about link-check flakiness? last time link-check passed but we had broken anchors in prod.
elaine: use `make link-check` and also run the anchor-fix script I wrote: `tools/docs/anchor-normalize.py`. It generates a mapping file anchor-map.yaml.
nina: good call, I'll run both before marking PRs ready. Also planning to post small "do not merge" markers on PR2/3 until PR1 is green.
ci-bot: PR1 preview: https://deploy-preview-140--docs.redwood.example.com (checks queued)
harry: ok I'll review PR2 snippets tomorrow. I can do an initial skim tonight.
raj: who's approver on PR1?
nina: suggested reviewers for PR1: ela ine + harry. For PR2: ben + harry. For PR3: raj + nina.
harry: I can do PR1 review at 10:40 PT.
elaine: reminder: add an entry in release notes about path changes so marketing knows how to update external links.
nina: noted. Also adding a small test harness in PR3 that asserts redirect-map resolution for old anchors.
ci-bot: PR1 link-check FAILED (2 anchors mismatch). Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/801
raj: please paste mismatches.
nina: 1) /reference/auth#oauth -> new #oauth-flow 2) /reference/sdk#init -> new #sdk-init
elaine: add temporary redirect rules for those anchor fragments in PR1 so we don't block merge.
nina: will add redirect rules and re-run.
ci-bot: PR1 rerun: link-check PASSED, html-validate PASSED.
harry: approved.
elaine: approved.
ci-bot: PR1 merged by harry. Deploy started.
nina: un-DNM PR2 and PR3. Will hold PR3 merge until we validate the prod deploy.
raj: I'll take PR3 review tomorrow.
ci-bot: deploy complete: status=success, url=https://docs.redwood.example.com
nina: follow-up: please report any 404s here. I'll monitor Sentry for new link errors and update anchor-map.yaml if needed.
harry: thanks everyone.
nina: closing thread, will open smaller follow-ups if we find edge cases.
